## Documentation Issue

**What type of documentation issue is this?**
- [ ] Missing documentation
- [ ] Incorrect information

- [ ] Broken links
- [ ] Code examples don't work
- [ ] API reference incomplete
- [ ] Other

## Location

**Where is the documentation issue?**
- File: [e.g. README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md]
- Section: [e.g. "Quick Start", "API Reference"]
- Line number (if applicable): [e.g. line 123]
- URL (if applicable): [e.g. https://github.com/gusdeyw/go-htmlemail#features]

## Current Content

**What does the documentation currently say?**
Copy and paste the relevant section or describe what's currently documented.

## Issue Description

A clear description of the documentation problem.

## Suggested Improvement

**What should the documentation say instead?**
Provide your suggestion for how to fix or improve the documentation.


**How important is this documentation fix?**
